latin: Sicut cognitio per demonstrationem habita homini, pro communi statu quem hic experimur, est perfectissima cognitio, ita simpliciter inter cognitiones est imperfectissima.
translation: Knowledge gained by demonstration is, for the common condition we experience here, the most perfect knowledge available to man; yet considered absolutely, among all kinds of knowledge it is the least perfect.
translation_note: Contrasts a relative perfection (for our present state) with knowledge's absolute rank; sense checked.
